QuestInfo.name: Utah's Pig Farm
QuestInfo.0: Utah, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, has something on his mind.
QuestInfo.1:
Utah wants to start a pig farm, but he needs some Ribbon Pigs to do that. Catch #b20 Mutant Ribbon Pigs#k with the rope Utah gave you.

#e#b* Use the item near the monster.
#e#b* The obtained quest item will be removed upon forfeiting the quest.
QuestInfo.2: You brought 20 Ribbon Pigs to Utah.

0.0: Oh, good to see you in town. As you can see, I made it home. I also heard you got the ingredients for Camila. Thank you. You're very kind.

yes.0: I'm thinking of starting the old pig farm back up. I thought of giving up, because the pigs changed from the Black Mage's influence but... I just can't stay away from it. I've thinking of taming some Ribbon Pigs.
yes.1: So I need to catch some Ribbon Pigs, but it's not easy. Too many monsters around. That's why I was hoping you could catch them for me. #b20 Mutant Ribbon Pigs#k, \nspecifically.
yes.2:
You can tie them up with this rope. Good luck!

#e#b* Use the rope near the monster.

no.0: You must be really busy! Please talk to me again when you have time.

0.1: I already owe you one, so I hate to ask this, but there's something else. I can't do it on my own. Could you help me out again?

1.0: You catch all the Ribbon Pigs I needed?

yes.0: Wow! Thank you very much! This will be enough to start the pig farm! Of course, I'll need to tame them first... Well, you've given me the opportunity here, and I'm not going to waste it!
yes.1: I can't let the Cygnus Knights bring me down. I'm going to do what I can!

item.0: If you catch #b20 Mutant Ribbon Pigs#k, I can take care of taming them. Just use the rope I gave you to tie them up.\r\n\r\n#e#b* Use the item near the monster.
